title: Amma bhara ghar lut gaya
body:
AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA, KARTI THI ZAINAB YE BUKA, KULSOOM NE NAUHA PADHA
POUNCHA WATAN JABQAFELA, DEKHI JO QABRE SAYEDDA, ZAINAB KA DIL PHATNE LAGA, KULSOOM NE NAUHA PADHA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
OUN-O-MOHAMMAD MARGAYE, QASIM BHI TUKDE HOGAYE, LAASHE PA JAB BHAIYYA GAYE, BIKHRA HUA LAASHA MILA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
AKBAR KA SEENA CHIDD GAYA, KADYAL JAWAAN MARA GAYA, LAASHE PA SARWAR NE KAHA, SHABBIR TANHA HOGAYA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
ABBAS KE SHAANE KATE, SAHIL PA GHAZI SOGAYE, BHAIYYA KAMAR KOTHAAM KE KEHTE THE BHAI MARGAYA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
ASGHAR BHI MAIDAN MEINGAYA, TEERE SITAM US PAR CHALA, MANKA BHI USKA DHAL CHUKA, BHAI KA BAZOO CHEED GAYA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYAAMMA
MAIN DETI THI SADA, HAI BHAI MERA BE QATA, PAR KUCH NA ZALIM NE SUNA MAAJAAYE KA KATA GALA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
SHAAME GAREEBA CHAGAYI, AUR BERIDA MEIN HOGAYI, THI BIBIYO KI BEBASI BACHON KI THI AAHO BUKA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
BACCHI KE GAUHAR CHIN GAYE, RONE PA DURRE BHI LAGE, MASOOM DUKHIYA KYA KARE ISS TARHA KA PURSA MILA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
BIMAAR PAR TOOTE SITAM, PADTE THE DURRE DAM BA DAM, PAAON MEIN CHHAALE AUR WARAM AUR MANZILO CHALTA RAHA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
BAAZU MEIN MERE THI RASAN, HONE LAGE RANJ O MEHAN, THA MERA BHAYI BE KAFAN AJRE RISALAT YOON MILA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
BE PARDA THE AHLE HARAM, GUZRE JO BAAZARO SE HUM, HASTE THE BANIYE SITAMAUR SHARM SE THA SAR JHUKA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
HAR GAAM PAR ZILLAT SAHI, QAIDI BANI DAR DAR PHIRI, AMMA MAINKYONNA MARGAYI DARBAR MEIN THI BE RIDA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
DARBAR JAKAR AAYI HOON, BAZARO SE HOO AAYI HOON, BACCHI KOKHOKAR AAYI HOON, AMMA SUNAO AUR KYA, AMMA BHARA GHAR LUT GAYA
